title: Eating disorder resources | NHS inform
text:
Eating disorder resources
Eating disorder support and information
Charities and support groups that deal with eating disorders
Beat
has a range of information on the help and support available for people with eating disorders, and their friends and families.
Cared Scotland
is designed for parents and young people in Scotland who have recently received a diagnosis of an eating disorder.
FEAST
is a global support and education community of and for parents of those with an eating disorder.
Freed
has information and support for you or for someone you’re worried about.
SupportED Scotland
is a community based charity across Scotland that support people with an eating disorder, their families and their carers.
Support and information for specific conditions
ARFID Awareness UK
provide support and information for people with ARFID and their loved ones.
Peace Pathway
supports people with an eating disorder and autism.
Mental health support helplines
Phone
111
and select the mental health option to be connected to a team for specialist support.
Talk to
Breathing Space
if you need someone to talk to.

Scottish Government
